verdict.rationale: Grok Build has a TUI Marketplace tab for browsing and installing plugins from configured sources, plus skills. Third-party MCP servers such as Linear's hosted endpoint can be added, and their tools sit alongside the built-in ones. It also reuses Claude Code and Cursor MCP and hook configs. However, nothing shows a curated catalog of partner-built agent apps; integration is through plugins and MCP tools rather than full partner agents. Missing for 10: a documented partner agent-app directory or program, evidence of partner-built agents (not just tools or plugins) running in workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration of the marketplace.
